## TabResourceClient.get() method

Get a tab of a window by its position A tab has no id, so it is selected by its zero-based position within its window, which drifts when tabs open, close or move.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get(windowId: string | number, index: string | number, __mactsOptions?: _macts_contracts.CallOptions): Promise<Tab>;
```
